remarks: Spacious luxury standalone unit in condo community in downtown Greenwich. A gourmet kitchen with large pantry opens to a large family room with gas fireplace. A large deck out from Family room. A lot of windows with cathedral ceiling for Living/dining rooms. Spacious primary bedroom with gas fireplace, vaulted ceiling, spa like bathroom and large walk-in-closet. Large lower-level bedroom has its own full bathroom, walk in closet, and sliding door to the private leveled backyard. Attached garage plus another reserved parking space. Close to RR station and downtown shopping and restaurants. Condo association maintains landscaping and snow removal.
